title: launchd plist points at /usr/local/bin/personad, which no documented install produces
description:
launchd/personal.atwood.persona.plist:9 sets ExecStart to /usr/local/bin/personad.

systemd/personad.service:8 uses %h/.cargo/bin/personad, which matches README.md:129 ('cargo install --path personad'). No documented step installs anything to /usr/local/bin, so the macOS LaunchAgent points at a path that will not exist after following the README.

Also related: persona-5s4b.34 notes the same plist writes logs to a predictable /tmp path.
